head: Beyond Notes markdown notes app for Mac, iPhone and iPad
dek: Beyond Notes is a new markdown notes app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that shows headings, lists and tables as a finished page while you type, and saves every note as a plain text file in your own iCloud Drive. Your first 50 notes are free.
details: It came out on 10 November from Beyond Beyond AB. It has seven themes, a daily journal page with "On this day", #tags, links between notes and checkboxes; an optional mode underlines stock phrases that make writing sound machine-made, on the device. After 50 notes, Beyond Notes Pro is a yearly plan with the first month free, a monthly plan or a one-time purchase. No account and no ads, and the listing says it collects no data.
where: iPhone, iPad and Mac, App Store, free for 50 notes
means: If you want notes that any text app can still open years from now, this keeps them as plain files in your iCloud.
todo: Get it free from the App Store and try it on up to 50 notes before deciding on Pro.
thumb_words: NOTES THAT GLOW AS YOU TYPE
